newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Two children abducted in Belgium.
newsitem.headline: Two children abducted in Belgium.

text.p: Belgian police were on nationwide alert on Monday after two children were abducted on Sunday on the outskirts of Brussels.
Belgian radio said the children, who were not named, were picked up by a Mercedes delivery van with a German number plate.
Belgium has been rocked over the past nine months by a child abduction, rape and murder scandal, in which five children have so far been found dead.
